description: An oil-painted interior shows a man kneeling on tatami mats in a dark grey robe and a grey cloth cap. He whisks green tea in a dark bowl with a bamboo whisk. An iron kettle sits on a glowing brazier to the left, with steam rising, and a small cup sits on the floor. A latticed window and a paper sliding door are behind him. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing gory.
